entities.name: Ao
entities.description: Dragon spirit of Kamigawa, reincarnation of Yosei, who avoids mortal affairs.

entities.name: Yosei
entities.description: Divine dragon guardian spirit of Kamigawa's plains and Eiganjo, ripped apart by O-Kagachi.

events.summary: Yosei is ripped apart in a clash with O-Kagachi and is reborn as Ao.
events.quote: being ripped apart during a clash with O-Kagachi

events.summary: Ao refuses to reclaim his old mantle as Eiganjo's defender after the city rose from its ruins.
events.quote: Ao has refused to reclaim his old mantle as Eiganjo's defender

relations.quote: He is the reincarnation of Yosei

relations.note: Ripped him apart in a clash.
relations.quote: being ripped apart during a clash with O-Kagachi
